title: Haryana sugarcane agitation threatens crushing season; farmers demand Rs 600 per quintal

ai.summary: Haryana sugarcane farmers demand Rs 600 per quintal for crushing season, rejecting the state's SAP of Rs 430 after citing rising costs and lower yields.

facts.claim: Sugarcane farmers’ demand for a higher procurement price has created uncertainty for Haryana’s sugar industry ahead of the crushing season
facts.quote: Rohtak: Sugarcane farmers’ demand for a higher procurement price has created uncertainty for Haryana’s sugar industry ahead of the crushing season, with growers threatening to stop cane supplies to mills unless the state raises the State Advised Price (SAP) to Rs 600 per quintal, Hindustan Times reported.

facts.claim: Farmers have rejected the recently announced SAP of Rs 430 per quintal
facts.quote: Farmers have rejected the recently announced SAP of Rs 430 per quintal, which includes an increase of Rs 15, saying the revision is insufficient to cover rising cultivation costs.

facts.claim: The Samyukta Kisan Morcha has also announced plans to gherao Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini’s residence in Kurukshetra on December 2 if the demand for a higher cane price is not accepted
facts.quote: The Samyukta Kisan Morcha has also announced plans to gherao Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini’s residence in Kurukshetra on December 2 if the demand for a higher cane price is not accepted.

facts.claim: Sugarcane production in 2025-26 was estimated at 536.24 lakh quintals, down 37.55% from 858.78 lakh quintals in 2020-21
facts.quote: Figures from the state Cooperation Department show that production in 2025-26 was estimated at 536.24 lakh quintals, down 37.55% from 858.78 lakh quintals in 2020-21.

ai.background_note: Haryana sugarcane production has declined significantly over the past five years, with farmers facing financial losses due to low price increases relative to inflation.
